name: 豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯

points.title: 童年与早期教育
points.description: 博尔赫斯出生于布宜诺斯艾利斯的一个书香门第，父亲是律师兼心理学教师，祖母精通英语。童年时期，博尔赫斯接触了多种语言和文化，尤其是英语和德语。他从小展现出非凡的文学天赋，8岁时开始写作，并阅读了大量经典文学作品。这段时期奠定了他日后多元文化视野和语言风格的基础。1914年，第一次世界大战爆发，博尔赫斯全家迁往欧洲。
points.descriptionEn: Borges was born into an educated family in Buenos Aires; his father was a lawyer and psychology teacher, and his grandmother was fluent in English. From an early age, Borges showed exceptional literary talent, beginning to write at age 8 and reading extensively from classic literary works. During this period, he developed a multicultural perspective and linguistic style that would later define his work. In 1914, with the outbreak of World War I, Borges and his family moved to Europe.

points.title: 欧洲求学经历
points.description: 在瑞士日内瓦，博尔赫斯进入中学学习，并开始系统接触哲学和文学。他精通了法语，并深入研究叔本华、尼采等哲学家的思想。这段欧洲经历极大地拓宽了他的文化视野，使他接触到欧洲现代主义文学思潮。1921年，博尔赫斯返回布宜诺斯艾利斯，但欧洲文化的影响已深深烙印在他的创作中，成为他日后作品中的重要元素。
points.descriptionEn: In Geneva, Switzerland, Borges attended secondary school and began systematically studying philosophy and literature. He mastered French and deeply engaged with the works of philosophers such as Schopenhauer and Nietzsche. This European experience significantly broadened his cultural horizons and exposed him to European modernist literary movements. In 1921, Borges returned to Buenos Aires, but European culture had already profoundly influenced his work, becoming a crucial element in his later writings.

points.title: 文学创作与政治活动
points.description: 返回阿根廷后，博尔赫斯积极参与文学活动，创办了《马丁·菲耶罗》等文学杂志，成为阿根廷先锋派文学的重要人物。他创作了大量诗歌、散文和短篇小说，形成了独特的文学风格。这一时期，博尔赫斯还担任了布宜诺斯艾利斯市立图书馆馆长。然而，由于反对胡安·庇隆政府，他在1946年被解除了图书馆职务，并被任命为'家禽市场稽查员'这一侮辱性职位。这一政治迫害深刻影响了他的创作，使他更加关注权力、自由和知识等主题。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to Argentina, Borges actively participated in literary activities, founding magazines like 'Martín Fierro' and becoming a key figure in Argentine avant-garde literature. He wrote numerous poems, essays, and short stories, developing a unique literary style. During this period, Borges also served as director of the Buenos Aires Municipal Library. However, due to his opposition to Juan Perón's government, he was dismissed from his library post in 1946 and appointed to the humiliating position of 'Inspector of Poultry Markets.' This political persecution profoundly influenced his work, leading him to focus more on themes of power, freedom, and knowledge.

points.title: 文学巅峰与学术成就
points.description: 庇隆政府倒台后，博尔赫斯被重新任命为国家图书馆馆长，并于1955年获得阿根廷国家文学奖。这一时期是他创作的黄金时代，创作了《虚构集》(1944)、《阿莱夫》(1949)、《布罗迪报告》(1970)等重要作品，确立了他在世界文学史上的地位。博尔赫斯的作品融合了哲学、数学、神秘主义和文学元素，创造出独特的'博尔赫斯宇宙'。同时，他在布宜诺斯艾利斯大学教授英国和美国文学，培养了一代文学爱好者。他的作品开始在国际上获得广泛认可，被翻译成多种语言。
points.descriptionEn: After the fall of the Perón government, Borges was reappointed director of the National Library of Argentina and received the National Prize for Literature in 1955. This period marked the peak of his literary career, with major works such as 'Ficciones' (1944), 'El Aleph' (1949), and 'Dr. Brodie's Report' (1970), establishing his place in world literary history. Borges' works blended philosophy, mathematics, mysticism, and literature, creating his unique 'Borges universe.' Simultaneously, he taught English and American literature at the University of Buenos Aires, inspiring a generation of literature enthusiasts. His works began to gain international recognition, being translated into multiple languages.

points.title: 晚年与全球声誉
points.description: 博尔赫斯晚年主要居住在欧洲，特别是瑞士日内瓦，这里是他童年的回忆之地。1971年，他获得西班牙文学的最高荣誉——塞万提斯奖，进一步巩固了他在国际文坛的地位。尽管晚年视力几乎完全丧失，博尔赫斯继续通过口授创作，并频繁参加国际文学活动。他的作品被广泛研究，成为后现代主义文学的重要先驱。1986年，博尔赫斯在日内瓦逝世，终年86岁。他的遗体被运回阿根廷安葬，但他的精神遗产已超越国界，影响了几代作家和思想家。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Borges primarily lived in Europe, particularly Geneva, Switzerland—a place connected to his childhood memories. In 1971, he received the Cervantes Prize, Spain's highest literary honor, further cementing his position in international literature. Despite near-total blindness in his later years, Borges continued dictating his work and frequently participated in international literary events. His works were widely studied, becoming an important precursor to postmodernist literature. Borges died in Geneva in 1986 at the age of 86. His body was returned to Argentina for burial, but his intellectual legacy had already transcended national boundaries, influencing generations of writers and thinkers.

supporter.zh: 博尔赫斯被誉为20世纪最伟大的作家之一，他的作品以其深邃的哲学思考、精妙的语言艺术和独特的叙事结构而著称。支持者认为他开创了'幻想现实主义'的文学风格，将形而上学思考与日常现实完美融合。博尔赫斯的作品超越了传统文学的界限，影响了后现代主义文学的发展。他的图书馆、迷宫、镜子等意象已成为世界文学的经典符号。尽管视力逐渐丧失，博尔赫斯的精神创造力却愈发旺盛，展现了人类思想的无穷可能性。
supporter.en: Borges is celebrated as one of the greatest writers of the 20th century, renowned for his profound philosophical thinking, exquisite linguistic artistry, and unique narrative structures. Supporters credit him with pioneering 'fantastic realism,' seamlessly blending metaphysical thought with everyday reality. His works transcended conventional literary boundaries, influencing the development of postmodern literature. Images of libraries, labyrinths, and mirrors in his work have become classic symbols in world literature. Despite his progressive blindness, Borges's creative spirit only intensified, demonstrating the infinite possibilities of human thought.

critic.zh: 批评者指出博尔赫斯的作品过于智力化和抽象，缺乏情感深度和社会关怀。他们认为博尔赫斯沉迷于哲学游戏和智力迷宫，忽视了文学的社会责任和情感共鸣。一些评论家认为他的作品晦涩难懂，自我指涉过多，形成了一种'博尔赫斯式的自恋'。此外，博尔赫斯对阿根廷政治的某些立场也受到批评，特别是他在庇隆时期的表现被一些人视为知识分子面对政治压力时的妥协。
critic.en: Critics argue that Borges' work is overly intellectualized and abstract, lacking emotional depth and social engagement. They contend that Borges became engrossed in philosophical games and intellectual labyrinths, neglecting literature's social responsibilities and emotional resonance. Some commentators find his work obscure and excessively self-referential, creating what they term a 'Borges-like narcissism.' Additionally, Borges' political positions in Argentina have drawn criticism, particularly his behavior during the Perón era, which some view as a compromise by intellectuals facing political pressure.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，博尔赫斯被定义为一位连接传统与现代、东方与西方的文学桥梁。他的作品影响了从卡尔维诺到马尔克斯等众多作家，成为后现代主义文学的重要先驱。博尔赫斯的'无限图书馆'和'沙之书'等概念已成为文化符号，象征着知识的无限性和人类认知的局限性。在流行文化中，他被视为'作家中的作家'，其作品被引用于电影、音乐和视觉艺术中。尽管争议不断，博尔赫斯无疑重塑了20世纪文学的边界，为后来的文学实验开辟了道路。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Borges is defined as a literary bridge connecting tradition and modernity, East and West. His work influenced numerous writers from Italo Calvino to Gabriel García Márquez, establishing him as an important precursor to postmodernist literature. Concepts like his 'Library of Babel' and 'Book of Sand' have become cultural symbols, representing the infinity of knowledge and the limitations of human cognition. In popular culture, he is regarded as 'a writer's writer,' with his work referenced in films, music, and visual arts. Despite ongoing controversies, Borges undoubtedly reshaped the boundaries of 20th-century literature, paving the way for subsequent literary experiments.

self.zh: 天堂应该是图书馆的模样。
self.en: I have always imagined that Paradise will be a kind of library.

others.zh: 博尔赫斯创造了一种新的文学语言，它既是哲学的，又是诗的，既是抽象的，又是具体的，既是理性的，又是神秘的。
others.en: Borges created a new literary language that is at once philosophical and poetic, abstract and concrete, rational and mysterious.
